notes.tv-*.json: Answers of the public Vigie API (vigie-api f757654) read on 2026-11-08 for the spot of Hossegor, kept under the id tv-hossegor: the television screen (/tv) reads the answers of a spot at the hour it is shown, so the mock replays them moved by whole days (as the aurora), to look recorded today.
notes.hazards-storms.json, forecast-*.json, vi: Answers of vigie-api a87136f to its own recordings of the NHC (Hurricane Isaias, advisory 13A, 2026-10-09) and of tsunami.gov (Panama, 2026-10-09 18:55 UTC), made with its test setup (tests/test_storm_api.py), because no storm and no tsunami were active on 2026-10-20.
notes.tides.json, tides-coast.json: Answers of vigie-api bdbaf8e (its pull request 32, which adds GET /v1/tides and /v1/tides/coast), run locally on 2026-10-28 with scripts/record-fixtures.mjs: the tide is computed by the API from the EOT20 model, with no provider; the public instance did not compute tides yet.
notes.surf-hossegor.json: Answers of vigie-api's surf branch (the pull request that adds GET /v1/surf/spots and /v1/surf/spots/{id}), run locally on 2026-10-29 with scripts/record-fixtures.mjs: the spots are bundled in the API (OpenStreetMap), the forecast asked Open-Meteo (MFWAM swell, wind) and computed the tide; the public instance did not serve the surf yet.
notes.surf-spots.json, surf-overview.json: Answers of vigie-api's branch that adds GET /v1/surf/overview and corrects the spot names OpenStreetMap misspells (Plage de la Marbella), run locally on 2026-10-29 with scripts/record-fixtures.mjs: the overview asked Open-Meteo once for the 51 spots (MFWAM swell, wind) and computed the tide; the public instance did not serve the overview yet.
notes.activities-overview.json: Answer of vigie-api's branch that adds GET /v1/activities/overview (the headline of the four activities of every surf spot), run locally on 2026-11-08 with scripts/record-fixtures.mjs: it read the two every-spot answers of the surf overview (Open-Meteo, once) and the cached coastal warnings; the public instance did not serve it yet. A calm day: the surf is poor everywhere (swell too small), the kite varies.
notes.sea-place*.json: Answers of vigie-api 41bfeff (its pull request 60, which adds GET /v1/sea/places and /v1/sea/places/{id}), run locally on 2026-11-08 with scripts/record-fixtures.mjs: the catalogue is a file bundled in the API (OpenStreetMap, the Sandre ports, the bathing results), built on 2026-11-08, so no provider is asked. The mock replies by the kinds, the words and whether a position is given, whatever the position or the page (e2e/mock-api.mjs): the places around Saint-Malo stand for the neighbours of every place.
